note: Narrow (5.2cm) justified column; long words carry soft hyphens (U+00AD, CSS hyphens: manual) so Chromium breaks them with a visible hyphen; compounds with real hyphens (porte-monnaie, c'est-à-dire...) may break after their hyphen.
signal: A hyphen at line end inside a soft-hyphenated word must disappear when joining; a real compound hyphen must stay ('porte-monnaie', not 'portemonnaie').
